problemStatement.currentContract: All candidates require CandidateValueVector and CausalOwnerTotals; only the selected candidate and actual alternatives require full causal facts and CandidateValueProof.
problemStatement.currentImplementation: evaluateAllCandidates invokes the proof-oriented component registry for every candidate, normalizes and freezes complete fact arrays, then materializeProof returns the causal facts already stored in the vector.
problemStatement.firstResponsibilityDeviation: The target kernel is proof-first rather than vector-first, so proof materialization cost is paid before Pareto and final selection can reduce the required proof set.

architectureAudit.mainProcessStaticFinding: r9v2TargetKernelComponentEvaluation constructs fact arrays for every candidate, evaluateAllCandidates normalizes those facts before Pareto, and materializeProof returns vector.causalFacts that already exist.
architectureAudit.independentEvidenceFinding: Events 144-155 did not remove the proof-first component lifecycle; the registry batch retained object-oriented component and proof construction.

event000142.conclusion: Proof component lifecycle, not provider ranking, dominated the measured Draft.

representativeTransaction.qualification: Structural estimate from a representative transaction; it is not claimed as a same-run timing sample for event000142.

theoreticalBound.expectedRange: 50%-64% Draft reduction if scalar evaluation costs no more than 0%-23% of the removed proof-first workload.
theoreticalBound.qualification: ProofComponentBuild is an inclusive hotspot containing S4 route and mechanical work. The estimate is an architecture upper bound, not an additive sum of nested timers.

rejectedDirectionsNotRepeated: transaction context and entry canonicalization without changing proof ownership
proof registry batching that still materializes all candidate facts
exact S4 objective delta layered over the proof-first pipeline

targetArchitecture.name: VectorFirstProofLateV1
targetArchitecture.retainedAcceptedBase: Keep the semantically accepted S4 branch-value columns and sparse dependency deltas; replace the remaining dirty-row mechanical realization and proof-first component lifecycle.
allCandidatePath: CausalContributionColumnsV1 with integer source identities and owner codes
requiredProofPath: selected candidate plus actual alternative IDs
proof totals reconciled against the previously selected vector
forbiddenInAllCandidatePath: component fact normalization and deep clone
full future-route row objects when only best scalar route values are required
complete Proof materialization before Pareto selection

information: stable candidate identity intersection committed value
kernelValidation: registered component and owner code validation
owner totals and goal reconciliation inside the kernel

implementationStages.change: Add a test-only vector component registry interface using columnar causal contributions and store CausalOwnerTotals separately from full causal fact objects; preserve the current proof-first interface as the A/B reference.
implementationStages.exit: 20 reference cases prove vector and proof paths remain field-equal with no production provider registration change.

implementationStages.change: Use the new vector interface only for S4 first: build baseline and observation outcome route-value columns, apply exact dependency deltas, and compute adaptive/committed/information values without materializing full route rows or S4 proof facts for every branch.
implementationStages.exit: The control-heavy first decision no longer rebuilds the 294 dirty mechanical rows as legacy objects; semantic cases are field-equal and worst-decision gain is at least 40%. Otherwise stop the architecture before scalarizing other domains.

implementationStages.change: After V2 clears the macro gate, compute remaining numeric owner totals and Pareto columns directly from canonical mechanical contributions without constructing causal fact objects.
implementationStages.exit: All non-S4 vector fields are equal within 1e-9; current full proof remains identical for required candidates.

implementationStages.change: Switch all-candidate evaluation to scalar vectors; materialize full proof only after alternatives are selected; fail if proof totals differ from vector totals by more than 1e-9.
implementationStages.exit: DecisionAuditV2 vector coverage and required-subset proof coverage remain closed.

semantic: candidate IDs, Pareto set, selection and alternatives equal
goal, information and objective values within 1e-9
required proofs and causal facts identical
duplicate causal source identities remain Fatal in the vector path
workload: all-candidate vector path materializes zero causal fact arrays
full proof component builds are limited to selected plus actual alternatives
no candidate, response, probability, fact or round reduction

performance.firstBoundedGate: team_control_overlap worst decision gain >=40% and no duel regression greater than 3%
performance.architectureAcceptanceGate: current worst transaction Draft gain >=50% or a measured lower bound that still reaches the five-round 10-second target

stopAndRollback: Any vector/proof mismatch rolls back the whole current stage.
If V2 plus V3 cannot demonstrate a measured >=40% bounded gain, stop before V4 and restore M5 BLOCKED.
If the scalar path requires hidden information, candidate reduction or approximate probabilities, reject the architecture.
Do not resume M6 until V4 and the formal M5 matrix complete.
